title: Shared types of the RoboRoute Nexus contract
description: Definitions shared by the remaining schemas. Explicit units: meters, seconds, kilograms, cubic meters, km/h, percentage and euro cents. The solver objective is expressed separately, in the model's own unitless scale.

nonNegativeMeters.description: Distance or length in meters (m), non-negative.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds (s) since the start of the scenario (t0).

euroCents.description: Amount in euro cents (EUR). Integer: money is never represented with binary decimals.

objectiveUnits.description: Internal optimizer cost in the model's own integer units. It is NOT money and is never shown as euros.

point3d.description: Point in the local Three.js world (XZ plane, Y up), in meters. Never latitude/longitude.

y.description: Elevation in meters. It is 0 across the whole city.

commandId.description: Command identifier (UUID v4). Repeating it does not mutate the state again.

nodeId.description: Stable road node identifier, e.g. N-001.

edgeId.description: Stable edge identifier with a canonical pair: the lower nodeId comes first. Never E-N002-N001 when N-001 < N-002.

vehicleId.description: Robot vehicle identifier, R-01 to R-06.

barrierId.description: Barrier identifier. The MVP allows 2 simultaneous active barriers.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 date and time in UTC with a Z suffix.

scenarioRevisionNumber.description: Scenario revision number. Monotonically increasing; it only grows with structural, plan or KPI changes.

tick.description: Simulation counter inside the current revision. It does not create new revisions.

graphVersion.description: Graph dataset version. Inside a scenario the graph is immutable.

vehicleStatus.description: Operational vehicle state: available, en route, delayed, blocked or finished.

priority.description: Order priority. URGENT has a strictly higher abandonment penalty than NORMAL and LOW.

solverOutcome.description: Outcome returned by the optimizer, translated from the OR-Tools state. The UI shows 'best routes found'; OPTIMAL describes the solver state, not a promise of optimality to the user.

unassignedReason.description: Reason why an order is left unassigned.

interventionKind.description: Intervention type that produced the current revision.

snapRejectionCode.description: Rejection reason for a claw or barrier snap.
